text:
A: Hello! Can you hear me? Sorry, I always click wrong button first.
B: Yeah, hi, I can hear you. I'm Kerry.
A: I'm Dorota, from Walsall. I saw your photo at the start, with the ginger cat. I said to myself, ah, her house is bit messy like mine, so we will get on. Sorry, that sounds rude!
B: No, it's true, to be fair. There was a book bag on the settee and everything. That's normal for us.
A: Same in my house. I have the post on the shelf, two books on the settee, a spider plant which is, erm, dying slowly. I'm not organised like other mums, you know?
B: Oh, me neither. I forgot non-uniform day again last week. Josh was the only one in uniform. He was so cross with me.
A: Oh no! Poor boy. My son is seventeen and he still can't get up for college. Every morning I shout, Kacper, the bus! And he says, five minutes, Mum. Five minutes is half hour.
B: Ha. Ellie's starting to be like that. She's twelve.
A: Twelve is when it starts, believe me. So what do you do, for work?
B: Erm, office admin at a plumbing firm. Part-time, so I can do the school run.
A: Part-time is good. I do three and half days, at pharmacy in Bloxwich. Pharmacy technician. Now is flu jab season, so is crazy, everybody coughing at the counter. I come home knackered, I don't want to cook tea, nothing.
B: What do you have then, when you're like that?
A: Fish fingers in a bap. Julie, the lady from Yorkshire, she laughed at me, she said I've gone West Midlands. Up there they say bread cake!
B: Bread cake? I've never heard that. We'd just say a roll, I think.
A: Everybody different. In Poland is bułka, so now I have three words. Erm, did you speak to Julie?
B: Yeah, she was nice. Bit, erm, she knows what she's doing, doesn't she.
A: Very. She told me I must ask my boss about a course, on Monday. I said Tuesday. Now I have to do it, she will ask me!
B: You should, though. I'd never ask, to be honest. I just like doing what I know.
A: Me too, that's problem. Sorry, what was the question again?
B: I don't think there was one. Erm, what do you watch? Everyone keeps asking me that.
A: Crime. Vera, Agatha Christie, and Polish series on the streaming. You?
B: Married at First Sight, mostly. Darren picks the crime ones. He'd probably like Vera.
A: Everybody likes Vera. She's messy too, in her car, all the rubbish. That's why I like her!
B: Ha, that's true actually. Her car's a state.
A: You see? Is not only us. Did you know Charlotte has dog called Biscuit, same as your cat?
B: Yeah, she told me. We had a laugh about it. Mine brought a mouse in again yesterday.
